games.title: Pinning
games.blurb: Pin a loop of rope so that pulling it tight cannot untangle it.
games.theorem: Simon & Stucky, the pinning ideal of a multiloop (arXiv:2405.16216)

games.title: Max-flow min-cut
games.blurb: Cut pipes until no water reaches the sink, spending as little as you can.

games.title: Art gallery
games.blurb: Station guards on the corners of a room until every part of it is watched.
games.theorem: Chvátal, with Fisk's proof — ⌊n/3⌋ guards always suffice

games.title: Coin weighing
games.blurb: Find the fake coin with a balance, against scales that answer as unhelpfully as honesty allows.
games.theorem: The counting bound — k weighings separate at most 3ᵏ cases

games.title: Hall’s marriage theorem
games.blurb: Give every applicant a job they can do — and when you cannot, prove it.
games.theorem: Hall; König — a matching exists unless some group shares too few jobs

games.title: Conway’s soldiers
games.blurb: Jump soldiers over each other to cross a line — there is a row nobody reaches.
games.theorem: Conway — 2, 4, 8, 20 soldiers reach rows 1 to 4, and row 5 is impossible

games.title: Sprague–Grundy
games.blurb: Four games that look nothing alike. Every one of them is Nim.
games.theorem: Sprague; Grundy, every impartial game is a Nim heap

games.title: Route inspection
games.blurb: Walk every street and come home, repeating as little as you can.
games.theorem: Guan; Edmonds & Johnson — the cheapest repeat is a matching on the odd corners

games.title: Sorting networks
games.blurb: Build a network that sorts every input, with as few comparators as you can.
games.theorem: The 0-1 principle — a network sorts everything iff it sorts every string of noughts and ones

games.title: Chomp
games.blurb: Eat the chocolate. Leave the poisoned corner for them.
games.theorem: Strategy stealing — the first player wins every rectangle, and the proof will not say how
